progress.scanning: Looking for LG soundbars nearby. This takes about 15 seconds.

user.title: Get your soundbar ready
user.description:
1. Switch the soundbar on.
2. Put it in Bluetooth pairing mode: on most LG soundbars, press **Function** until the display shows **BT**.
3. If your phone is connected to the soundbar, disconnect it.

Then select **Submit** to look for it. This takes about 15 seconds.

pick.title: Choose your soundbar
pick.description:
LG soundbars found: {count}.

If yours is missing, make sure it is in Bluetooth pairing mode and start again, or enter its Bluetooth address.

data_description.address: The soundbar to set up, or its Bluetooth address.

pair.title: Pair with the soundbar
pair.description: Keep the soundbar in Bluetooth pairing mode (the display shows **BT**), then select **Submit** to pair with {name}.

connect.title: Connect to the soundbar
connect.description:
Could not connect to {name}.

Make sure it is switched on and close to the Home Assistant host, then select **Submit** to try again.

options.title: Choose options
options.description: How Home Assistant connects to {name}, and which input it switches to when it turns the soundbar on. You can change these later in the integration's options.

data_description.turn_on_input: The input to switch to after Home Assistant turns the soundbar on, which wakes it on Bluetooth. Last input returns it to the input it was last seen on; Default leaves it on Bluetooth.
data_description.auto_connect: Connect when the soundbar comes on, and at startup if it is on. Connecting briefly switches the soundbar to Bluetooth and disconnects LG's app.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check whether the soundbar is on while Home Assistant is not connected to it. Checking does not wake the soundbar.

emergency_mode.title: {name} is in emergency mode
emergency_mode.description:
{name} reports emergency mode, which a failed firmware update can leave it in. Until it is recovered, it offers no other controls.

Open LG's Sound Bar app on a phone and connect to the soundbar: the app offers its recovery update. This issue goes away once the soundbar reports normal mode.
